title: Cross-sectional Ct distributions from qPCR tests can provide an early warning signal for the spread of COVID-19 in communities
summary: Ct-derived epidemic trajectories were added to a deep-learning forecast and evaluated against observed cases at 7- and 14-day horizons, including prospective January–April 2022 testing; supports earlier signals and forecast-error improvement in the studied campus and county data, not general epidemic surveillance. Full Methods/Results were reviewed.
